summary: Bulk procurement and temporary burst seats for internal AI evaluation suite (30 seats, 3-month pilot)
description:
Issue summary: Research & Applied ML requests procurement of 30 temporary seats for a 3-month pilot of a cloud-based AI evaluation/annotation tool (Vendor: EvalStream). The seats are needed to run model comparisons, human evals, and labeler bursts for scheduled Q2 experiments.

Impact: Without the burst seats the team cannot complete scheduled eval runs starting 2026-03-16, which would delay model rollout decisions and downstream benchmarking. Risk to timelines for two product experiments (LLM ranking and RLHF validation).

Requested change: Procure 30 named user seats for 3 months with option to extend to 6 months. Include SCIM provisioning into Redwood Okta group "evalstream-pilot" and invoice to cost center RND-33. Provide SSO, export/retention policy documentation, and SOC2 evidence.

Justification: Short-term burst is cost-efficient vs full annual commitment while evaluation is ongoing. Previous vendor comparison (EvalStream vs LabelBox Lite) favors EvalStream for integrated eval metrics and faster export pipelines.

Budget & approval: Estimated cost $18,000 for 3 months (line item in budget request attached). Finance approval required from manager Claire Gomez.

Steps taken so far:
- Research runbook reviewed: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Eval+Tool+Selection
- Procurement intake form submitted to VendorOps on 2026-03-08 (ticket VND-2026-03-08-01).
- Security questionnaire request initiated with Security (sec-req-2026-03-09).

Attachments: Quote (EvalStream_Q3_pilot_2026.pdf), budget request spreadsheet (RND33_eval_budget.xlsx).
requested_items: SCIM provisioning configured to Okta group evalstream-pilot
SOC2/SSAE18 evidence and data retention policy
Billing to cost center RND-33, PO or invoice as required
acceptance_criteria: Seats provisioned and visible in vendor admin dashboard
Users can SSO via Okta and are added to evalstream-pilot group
Invoice received and mapped to RND-33 in Coupa or accounting system
Security artifacts uploaded to vendor-evidence S3 and link shared in ticket
